description: Monthly offense rates (per 100k population), raw counts, population denominators and provider reporting coverage from FBI CDE. National scope omits identifiers; state requires only state_abbr; agency requires only ori. Identifiers are case-insensitive; start must be no later than end. Missing coverage stays null and participation may be incomplete. Offenses: violent-crime, property-crime, robbery, burglary, larceny, motor-vehicle-theft, arson, aggravated-assault, rape, homicide.

from_year.description: Start year of the data range (inclusive). The API uses monthly granularity.

offense.description: Offense type: violent-crime, property-crime, robbery, burglary, larceny, motor-vehicle-theft, arson, aggravated-assault, rape, or homicide.

ori.description: Nine ASCII-letter/digit ORI code (e.g. CA0010400, DCMPD0000); case-insensitive. Only permitted and required for agency scope.

scope.description: Geographic scope: national (omit identifiers), state (only state_abbr), or agency (only ori).

state_abbr.description: Two ASCII-letter state abbreviation (e.g. CA, DC, PR); case-insensitive. Only permitted and required for state scope.

to_year.description: End year of the data range (inclusive).

name: fbi_get_crime_estimates

data_last_updated.description: Date the CDE last refreshed this data.

entity_name.description: Provider entity selected from scoped offense actuals.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: The complete starting year/month is later than the ending year/month. `scope_param_incompatible`: Identifiers are supplied for a scope that does not apply them. `scope_param_missing`: scope is "state" but state_abbr is missing, or scope is "agency" but ori is missing. `no_data`: No data was returned for the requested offense and date range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

max_data_date.description: Latest data date reported by CDE, in the provider format.

participated_population.description: Provider participating population for this entity and month; null when unavailable.

population.description: Provider population for this entity and month; null when unavailable.

population_coverage_percent.description: Provider reporting coverage percentage for this entity and month; never calculated or borrowed, null when unavailable.

title: FBI Get Crime Estimates
